BestModal Enterprise Sales Manual
Artifact 

The manual is published — 37 modules and 6 appendices, built from bestmodal.de, your Acceltra research memorandum, and fresh research on competitors, DACH buying mechanics and cycle benchmarks. It's written for a technical founder who knows freight pricing cold and enterprise sales not at all.

A few things worth knowing about the choices inside it:

The strongest positioning is the one your own research already identified — "the pricing layer between carrier tariffs and the TMS." I built the whole competitive section around it, because it converts CargoWise and Descartes from fights you lose into incumbents you sit beneath.

Rail and barge are treated as your sharpest targeting filter, not just a feature. An independent 2026 comparison of seven ocean rate platforms found no meaningful rail coverage and no barge coverage at all across the field. Your research reaches the same conclusion from the other direction. So the manual weights the account list hard toward Rhine-corridor and intermodal accounts.

There's a timely wedge with a short shelf life. WiseTech moved ~95% of CargoWise customers to per-transaction pricing on 1 December 2025 with about a month's notice; reported increases run 20–50%+. Your fixed country-direction pricing is the natural counter for a CFO. The manual uses it to open doors and explicitly warns against building a strategy on it.

Part F is the part I'd read first. German deals die on security review, DSGVO and the Betriebsrat, always at the end. The works-council module covers §87(1) No. 6 BetrVG and the five German-language documents that turn that gate from a crisis into a handover — plus one small product change (a toggle to anonymise per-user activity data) that would neutralise the hardest objection permanently.

The one thing the manual asks for that doesn't exist yet is the procurement-readiness pack — thirteen documents, roughly two weeks of unglamorous work, reusable on every German deal forever. I've written the project doc with that and five other gaps listed, so it carries into future sessions.

Sources: bestmodal.de · acceltra.de/research.html · CargoWise Value Pack pricing 2026 · CargoWise pricing model · Descartes Global Price Management · Ocean rate management platforms compared · Works councils and German software deals · DACH procurement-first playbook · B2B sales cycle benchmarks · transport logistic 2027 · FIATA World Congress 2026
